title: A Cache Interaction Graph for Data Locality Optimization
problem: Cache efficiency optimization and root-cause diagnosis of cache inefficiencies in programs is difficult due to complex interactions between data access patterns and cache hierarchy
motivation: Performance gap between CPUs and memory systems is critical; existing profiling tools identify bottlenecks but don't diagnose root causes
method: Track cache line evictions; measure temporal and spatial locality; classify cache miss types; visualize via Cache Interaction Graph; extend Cachegrind for variable-level analysis
key_novelty: Cache Interaction Graph visualization correlating miss patterns with data access interactions to identify root causes and guide optimizations
contributions: Novel Cache Interaction Graph visualization technique
Variable-level data locality analysis with cache miss classification
Effective root-cause diagnosis methodology for cache inefficiencies
limitations: Limited to application-level profiling; overhead analysis on large-scale systems not fully explored
